summary: Full-stack test of LNMO multi-tenant School ERP MVP. Backend: created pytest suite (36 tests) covering auth (login/me/refresh/logout/lockout/inactive), platform CRUD (tenants/institutions/plans), institution CRUD (students/teachers/classes/sections/subjects), users management, institution profile, stats, audit, RBAC and cross-institution isolation — 36/36 PASS. Frontend: Playwright E2E across platform console (login, dashboard stats, tenant create/edit/delete, plan CRUD with shadcn Select, institution creation with admin account, audit log 25 rows, logout), institution console (dashboard 6 stat cards, students CRUD, teachers/classes/sections/subjects create+delete, users create with role Select, duplicate-email error in dialog, settings load+save+persist, pagination 20 records over 2 pages, search, theme toggle), role guards (unauth /app/* -> /login, inst-admin -> /access-denied, platform-admin -> /access-denied, teacher -> /portal-coming-soon and blocked from /app/*), brute-force lockout message after 5 fails. Auth playbook verified: bcrypt $2b$12$ hash, httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None+Partitioned cookies, unique index on users.email, login_attempts index, seed_admin re-hashes when env password changes. All test data cleaned; DB back to empty-start with only the seeded platform admin.

critical.issue: No cascade cleanup. Deleting an institution leaves its users, students, teachers, classes, sections, subjects and audit rows behind. The orphaned institution_admin can still log in (200) and reach /app/dashboard, but GET /api/institution/profile then returns 404 so /app/settings is permanently broken and user.institution_name is null. Reproduced: 4 orphan users remained after institution deletes. Needs cascade delete (or soft-delete + block login when institution missing/inactive).

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True combined with CORS_ORIGINS="*" is an invalid pair for credentialed cross-origin requests (browsers reject wildcard + credentials). Works today only because the preview ingress makes frontend/backend same-origin. Use explicit origin list from env.
Restricted to institution_admin only, so a platform_admin can list users (GET) but cannot create/edit/delete any — GET/mutation permissions are inconsistent.

No Pydantic model / field whitelist: arbitrary keys and types are persisted (e.g. status can be any string, email/phone never validated, capacity/price accept strings). Only 'name/first_name required' is enforced.
No password strength/length validation for created login accounts (1-char password accepted).

ui_bugs.issue: Action label built as `{a.action}d` renders wrong copy: 'lnmopvt@gmail.com logind session' for login events. Use a label map (login -> 'signed in', create -> 'created', ...).
Only offers 'Back to sign in'; a logged-in user who hits /access-denied has no link back to their own console and no user menu / logout on that page.
In edit mode the Password field renders empty with no helper text; users cannot tell that leaving it blank keeps the existing password.

integration_issues.issue: Effects fire twice (React StrictMode) so GET /api/institution/profile, /api/auth/me and /stats each run twice. On /app/settings the late second GET overwrites the form state, so text typed within ~1.5s of page load is silently discarded and the stale value is PUT instead. Reproduced once (name edit lost); passed when typing was delayed. Guard with an ignore/abort flag in the effect.

issues: 124px horizontal overflow — the 6 stat cards / quick-actions grid is clipped and the page scrolls sideways; grid needs to respect the mobile container width
'Quick actions' card is stretched to the height of the activity feed leaving a large empty white block below the last link (use items-start / self-start)
Date of birth uses the native browser date input (type="date") instead of the shadcn calendar/date-picker used elsewhere in the design system

action_items: Add cascade cleanup on institution delete (users + all institution-scoped collections) and/or block login for users whose institution no longer exists
Fix mobile horizontal overflow (124px) on institution dashboard stat grid
Guard the settings/dashboard fetch effects against double-invoke overwriting typed form state
Replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' + allow_credentials with an explicit origin list from env
Add Pydantic request models / field whitelist + password strength validation for /api/res/{resource} and /api/users
Align platform_admin permissions on /api/users (currently read-only while GET is allowed)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: generic /api/res/{resource} accepts unvalidated free-form dicts — add per-resource Pydantic schemas; today a client can store any field/type in any collection.

server.py create_resource: institution row is inserted before the admin-email uniqueness check and then rolled back with a manual delete_one — reorder the check before insert to avoid a non-atomic window.
server.py: no cascade/tenant integrity — institutions are not linked to tenants and deleting an institution orphans users and academic records.

Frontend data fetching effects (PlatformDashboard, InstitutionDashboard, InstitutionSettingsPage, ResourcePage) share the same load/error pattern; extract a small useFetch hook (DRY) and add an is-stale guard.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all functional flows pass; 1 race + copy/layout defects)

seed_data_creation: Created and then removed: test tenants/plans, 3 institutions with institution_admin accounts (test_admin_*, uiadmin578054@greenwood.test / Green@2026!), a teacher user, 20 PAGE_* students for pagination. DB restored to empty-start state (only seeded platform admin, all audit logs purged).
test_credentials: Platform admin lnmopvt@gmail.com / Lnmo@2026! (works). Institution admins are created on demand — /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py provisions its own (Green@2026!).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v` — it self-provisions institutions/admins with a random suffix and cleans up institutions on teardown (note: orphan users remain because backend has no cascade delete; purge with mongosh db.users.deleteMany({role:{$ne:'platform_admin'}}) if needed). Use /app/backend/tests/seed_ui_pagination.py <email> <password> <n> to seed students for UI pagination. Frontend flows already verified: platform tenant/plan/institution CRUD, institution students/teachers/classes/sections/subjects CRUD, users create + duplicate error, settings, pagination, search, theme toggle, all role guards, lockout message. Retest focus after fixes: institution delete cascade, settings typing race, ActivityFeed wording, mobile 390px overflow.
rca_of_the_issue: Cascade issue: delete_resource only removes the single document from its own collection; users and institution-scoped collections keep institution_id references, and get_current_user/login never check that the referenced institution still exists — hence orphan admins log in successfully but /institution/profile 404s. Settings race: useEffect in InstitutionSettingsPage has no stale-response guard, so under StrictMode double-invocation the second GET's setValues overwrites user input typed before it resolved.
